result:
T-DG5-FE-A is done. All four D-144 items are in place and every required check exits 0. The changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. One part of REQ-S03-007, hiding areas on the server, can't be done in this task (see the open items below).

The DG4 historical validator passed at the start and at the end (exit 0). The run took 02:29:09Z to 03:55:02Z, about 86 minutes.

**What was delivered**
- **Navigation and placeholders (item 1):** 17 new P5 menu entries and 26 more P5 routes (43 placeholder routes in all). Each placeholder says in English and Arabic that the screen is not available yet. It shows no data, no form and makes no request beyond the session. Each route row names the FE task that replaces it.
- **Landing pages (item 3):** each of the 10 areas that isn't itself a working screen now has a landing page listing its §3 contents in §3's order. Each item says where it lives: a workspace tab, an existing screen, or a P5 screen marked "Not available yet". The labels are tested against the §3 sentences in both languages.
- **Planned texts corrected:** Playbook and Procedures, Risks and Actions, Change and Adoption, and BAU and Improvement lost their "Planned" tag, because their DG4 screens exist. I removed `nav.plannedBody`, which said "this page shows no data" and is no longer rendered.
- **API client (item 2):** `api/p5.ts` has query keys, paths for all 72 slice A–C operations (each checked against `openapi.yaml`) and 37 read hooks. Hooks whose response schemas don't exist yet in the shared package take the body type as a parameter, defaulting to `unknown`.
- **Problem keys (item 4):** 73 English and Arabic keys covering every refusal code in ADR-0039 to ADR-0042, including the three BE-A named. The English matches each ADR's text exactly.
- **Admin visibility:** the Administration area is now also shown to the methodology administrator, so the Studio entries are reachable.

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| typecheck, build, lint, prettier, openapi:lint | all exit 0 (724 operations) |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | exit 0 both: 1618, 1385, and 259 + 2 skipped by design |
| integration | 2031/2031; no pinned-count change |
| e2e: `journeys`, `p3-seams`, new `p5-shell`, chromium-en and chromium-ar | 28/28; axe 0 serious or critical |

- The web count rose from 1358 to 1385: 35 new tests, minus 8 planned-area tests that no longer apply.
- I hardened one test's parser after the full unit runs, then re-ran the web project in both locales: 1385/1385 each.
- Intermediate failures (two type errors, one Arabic glossary hit on "معيارين") were fixed before the recorded runs; all are listed in the handback.
- Screenshots of all 10 landing pages and two placeholders, in both languages, are in the evidence folder. I looked at three of them; layout and right-to-left mirroring are correct.

**Operations routed:** none. This is a web-only task with no pending list.

**Needs a decision or another owner**
- **Server-side hiding:** REQ-S03-007's "hidden server-side" needs `GET /me/navigation`, which isn't in the contract yet (slice I). Until it exists, the menu filter is only a UI hint.
- **ADM_METHOD on `/admin`:** `AdminHomePage` (not my file) still shows "no permission" to the methodology administrator at `/admin`, though the Studio sub-entries work. FE-B or you should add a methodology section there.
- **`admin.plannedSections`** (not my file) says these settings are "planned for later releases", but they are P5 screens of this release. The handback suggests rewording; it is currently FE-B's to fix.
- **Placeholder tags in the menu:** P5 entries carry no "not available yet" tag in the menu itself, only on their pages. Adding one is a one-line change in `Shell.tsx`, which isn't mine.

I changed `app.test.tsx`, `journeys.spec.ts` and `p3-seams.spec.ts` because they pinned the old planned-area structure; that is the same set FE-R11 updated. Contract, schema or dependency needs: none.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/`:
- `T-DG5-FE-A-frontend-ux-engineer.md`
- `T-DG5-FE-A-evidence/`
